_comment: Merge this into ~/.claude/settings.json (or .claude/settings.json in a project). Verified 2026-09-30 against an installed Claude Code: settings.json carries a `hooks` object keyed by event, each a list of {matcher, hooks:[{type, command, timeout}]}. Exit code 2 from the command blocks the tool call; stdout JSON {"decision":"block","reason":...} also blocks. csl emits both, and also the Hermes dialect ("action"/"message"), so the same command works unchanged on Hermes.
